name: Maldives
summary: The Maldives has had a personal income tax since 2020 (Income Tax Act 25/2019): 0% up to MVR 720,000 rising to 15% above MVR 2.4M. Full residents are taxed on worldwide income including capital gains and foreign dividends; dividends from Maldivian companies are exempt. But a foreigner living in the Maldives on an immigration permit (and not married to a Maldivian) is a 'temporary resident' taxed only on Maldivian-source income, so a foreign family's foreign portfolio would be untaxed. No wealth, inheritance or gift tax. Long-term residence for wealthy foreigners is hard to obtain.

regimes.name: Maldives tax residence (full resident)
regimes.description: Worldwide taxation at up to 15% (applies to Maldivians and foreigners married to Maldivians).
regimes.eligibility: Permanent home in the Maldives or 183+ days in a 12-month period, and not a temporary resident.

capital_gains.summary: Capital gains are part of taxable income and taxed at the individual progressive rates (top 15% above MVR 2.4M) (Income Tax Act 25/2019, ss. 3 and 7). Residents are taxed on worldwide income (s. 10(a)).
open_questions: Lloyds Bank Trade states 'no capital gains tax is levied', contradicting CTL's reading of the Act; the Act itself (MIRA site blocks automated access) was not read.
Individual rate brackets after any 2024-2026 amendments were not verified (Lloyds lists the same brackets as '2023 brackets').
capital_gains.rate_basis: Top marginal rate 15% applies above MVR 2.4M (~EUR 135k); a large gain is taxed at about 15%.
capital_gains.foreign_assets: Full residents: worldwide, with a foreign tax credit (s. 72) capped at the Maldivian tax.

dividends.summary: Dividends received by a resident from a resident company are exempt (s. 12). Foreign dividends of a full resident are taxable at progressive rates up to 15%, with a foreign tax credit.
dividends.rate_basis: Domestic 0 (exempt); foreign at the 15% top marginal rate.
dividends.treaty_network: Very small (a handful of treaties; not verified).

wealth_tax.property_tax_note: No recurring property tax on individuals was found. Foreigners cannot own freehold land (leasehold only).

inheritance.summary: No inheritance, estate or gift tax. Gifts are exempt income subject to a de minimis rule and conditions (s. 12).
open_questions: Conditions of the s. 12 gift exemption not verified.
inheritance.important_exceptions: Succession, not tax, is the issue: personal status law based on Sharia governs the estates of Muslims (fixed shares; a son typically takes twice a daughter's share; at most one third freely disposable by will to non-heirs). How estates of non-Muslim foreigners are handled (law of nationality, own religious rules, or Sharia by default) was not verified here; non-Muslim families should take local legal advice.

regimes.name: Temporary resident (foreigner on an immigration permit)
regimes.description: Foreigners staying under a permit granted under the Immigration Act are taxed only on Maldivian-source income.
regimes.eligibility: A foreign individual who would otherwise be resident but stays in the Maldives under a permit granted under the Maldives Immigration Act, and is not married to a Maldivian.
regimes.duration_note: Status lasts for as long as the person stays under an immigration permit and is not married to a Maldivian; no statutory time limit (Income Tax Act 25/2019, temporary-resident definition; s. 2(c) as amended by Law 15/2021). In practice limited by the availability of long-term permits.

capital_gains.summary: Temporary residents are taxed only on Maldivian-source income, so gains on foreign securities and foreign real estate are untaxed. Maldivian-source gains are taxed at up to 15%.

sources.title: First amendment to the Income Tax Act (Law 15/2021)

open_questions: Source rules for gains on foreign shares held through a broker were not verified against the Act.
capital_gains.rate_basis: Foreign listed securities and foreign real estate 0 (outside the source rule). Domestic assets at the 15% top rate.

dividends.summary: Foreign dividends are outside the scope for temporary residents; dividends from Maldivian companies are exempt.

sources.title: First amendment to the Income Tax Act (Law 15/2021)

residency.tax_residency_test: Resident if the permanent home is in the Maldives or present 183+ days in a 12-month period starting or ending in the tax year. A foreigner present under an immigration permit and not married to a Maldivian is a temporary resident taxed only on Maldivian-source income.

routes.name: Work / business visa
routes.requirements: Long-term stay requires a work or business visa tied to employment or an approved investment; no residence-by-investment programme was verified.

corporate.summary: Companies 15% above MVR 500,000 (0% below); banks 25% (Income Tax Act 25/2019, ss. 8-9).

us_citizen_notes: US citizens remain US-taxed; no US-Maldives tax treaty.
